meaning_en: A rule lacks the rate, affinity, or time constants (kcat·Km, Kd, half-life) needed to decide competition, duration, or termination.
Molar concentration, molecules per cell, compartment volume, or mass balance is absent, so starting amounts rest on defaults or infinite pools.
3D coordinates, residue numbering, stoichiometry, or membrane topology is unknown or borrowed from another molecule.
No regeneration or supply path, or its rate, so a reservoir depletes and the pathway stalls; a post-mortem named it limiting. Closes when a supply rule's rate and starting amount arrive.
Mediating steps of signal-to-metabolism or metabolism-to-gene regulation (receptor, STAT, mTORC1, chromatin) are lumped into one modulation rule, or its constants (K·n·fmax) are unknown.
The error bars of available observations cannot separate competing hypotheses, or no observation exists to judge against.
A required external ID (ChEBI, UniProt, …) could not be matched against the source, leaving only a stated reason in unmapped. Closes when a verified ID arrives.
A stored value disagrees with a newer source consensus (trend mismatch, grade demoted to legacy), or no new source exists to check the trend. The value is not deleted — why it diverged is the datum.
Molecule count per cell or compartment (dimension: count).
Molar concentration in mol/L.
Dimensionless fraction or ratio of a quantity (0–1).
Time at which a state or threshold is first reached (seconds).
Compartment or cell volume (litres).
A rate or affinity constant read out as the observable (kcat, Km, Kd, half-life).
Dimensionless ratio of two forms or targets (normalized band intensity, active fraction, fold-change).
Fraction of an ensemble whose amount is at or above a gating threshold (percent-positive, e.g. flow cytometry).
The readout is higher under the perturbation than in the control.
The readout is lower under the perturbation than in the control.
The readout is indistinguishable from the control within the declared equivalence margin.
The feature or species is present under the perturbation.
The feature or species is absent under the perturbation.
The readout rises monotonically across the readout series.
The readout falls monotonically across the readout series.
The readouts follow a declared rank order.

A conservation law exists for this quantity (mass/moiety balance), so it has an exact reference and a target error of 0. Carried as integer counts in the ledger; numerical error is eliminated by construction, not merely tracked.

No conservation law exists for this quantity, so there is no exact reference. Kept as float and its error is tracked as a budget (cannot be driven to 0). It is never mixed into the conserved ledger or the stored biology constants, and is never forced into fixed-point to feign exactness.
A count of molecules or moieties, conserved by mass balance (sum-in = sum-out) even as reactions create and consume it.
A per-unit-time change (1/s), such as a reaction rate — not a conserved substance.
A size-independent thermodynamic or environmental variable (ΔG, pH, temperature); it does not add up, so there is no balance to conserve.
Derived from conserved counts by a scaling or ratio (concentration = count × cinv; a fraction). Carries a float scale and has no conservation law of its own.
A derivative of the dynamics (Jacobian ∂rate/∂N) — a sensitivity, not a substance, so nothing is conserved.
An emergent quantity such as a first-passage event time; it has no reference answer, so its error is a budget only.
An empirically measured or set input (kcat, Km, Kd, half-life, a volume setting); it arrives with uncertainty and has no conservation law.
A literature value measured for this species and reaction; the firm floor of a conclusion.
Derived from a measurement by a tool; trusted like the measurement but carrying the tool's assumptions.
A mechanism lumped into one constant; the detail is folded and its boundary is registered as a Structural_Gap.
An estimate or a scenario-set hypothetical value, not a measurement; the conclusion is conditional on it.
No rate constant: event-based (immediate) in the pathway rate run, switched off in the fate engine (Kinetic_Gap); timing and the link's effect cannot be stated.
Run under a preregistered simulation protocol whose input hash matches the registry; agreement is concluded only from the protocol's validation set.
A protocol is declared but not registered, or was edited after registration; no validation conclusion.
The preregistration registry was not supplied, so registration could not be confirmed; not read as validation until checked.
A hypothetical run without a protocol; it makes no claim of agreement with observations.
No preregistered protocol, so no conclusion of agreement with observations.
A result, not a defect: report it and do not fix it; if no regeneration path exists, register a limitation (Resource_Gap etc.).
Register it in the limitation registry and fill it only with confirmed values through a patch (never invent).
Data contradict each other (rules, stoichiometry, constants, observations): patch the data with evidence deciding which side is wrong.
Fix at the coupling points in engine/coupling.js or the solver step control; never change biological constants in db.json.
Fix the engine code; do not mask it by changing data or coupling points.
Fix compiler/ (IR, symbolic differentiation, tape); do not mask it by changing the engine or data.
Takes part without being consumed (enzyme, carrier, actor) in a step.
Consumed by a step.
Produced by a step.
Modulates a step without being consumed.
The parent along the is_a axis.
The whole this is part of (part_of axis).
The type this is an instance of (instance_of axis).
A child along the is_a axis.
A part of this whole (has_part axis).
A concrete instance of this type.
What leads to the state: the transition signal is on and the state is reached.
Necessity: cutting something under the same signal prevents reaching the state.
The ordinary situation: the starting state with no driven transition.
A mechanism path with the claimed sign exists in the graph.
No mechanism path connects the perturbation to the readout.
Only paths with the opposite sign exist.
Paths of both signs exist; only a simulation can decide.
A path exists although the observation claims no effect.
This observation kind is not judged on the qualitative graph.
The search bound was reached before a verdict.
The simulated direction or presence agrees with the observation.
The simulated outcome disagrees with the observation.
The simulation cannot resolve a difference at its resolution (not a disagreement).
The comparison is void (e.g. the perturbation-difference check failed).
The stored value agrees with the current source consensus.
The stored value differs from the current consensus; it is kept and graded legacy.
No trend check within the window.
The step size hit its lower bound; accuracy was compromised (NUMERICAL).
A large fraction of integrator steps were rejected.
Widely separated timescales, absorbed by the L-stable integrator.
Many active rules make the linear solves expensive.
No stiffness symptom.
Maximum catalytic turnover (s^-1).
Substrate concentration at half-maximal rate (M).
Rate constant; unit depends on reaction order.
Reverse-reaction rate constant.
Binding rate constant (M^-1 s^-1).
Unbinding rate constant (s^-1).
Equilibrium dissociation constant (M).
Pre-exponential factor of a transition-state rate law.
Activation free energy (J/mol).
Standard transformed reaction Gibbs energy (J/mol).
Time for half of the quantity to be lost (s).
Half-saturation constant of a Hill term (M).
Hill coefficient (dimensionless).
Maximum fold factor of an activating Hill term.
Minimum fold factor of an inhibiting Hill term.
Source score 4: an authoritative database confirmed by a judicial stamp.
Source score 3: peer-reviewed primary literature.
Source score 2: unsourced, inferred or predicted.
Source score 0: cannot be confirmed.
Data score 4: a traceable measurement or a tool computation from one.
Data score 3: a summary constant or an identity fact.
Data score 2: inferred, simplified or unsourced.
Usable as a fixed point of the simulation (S4 ∧ D4 ∧ trend agrees).
Usable as a main parameter (S ≥ 3 ∧ D ≥ 3).
Usable only with error bars.
For comparison only; never deleted.
Narrative only; not used in computation.
Not to be computed with or cited; kept only as a limitation.
